params.val: doubles a Berry's HP/stat-restoration amount and any stat-boost amount it grants when the holder eats it

verified via Showdown source, and it's more specific than a blanket "doubles Berry effects": (1) the doubling only applies to items flagged as a true Berry — Berry Juice and Leftovers show a Ripen activation message but their heal amount is NOT doubled; (2) separately, after eating a damage-reducing Berry (e.g. Occa Berry against a Fire move), the NEXT hit's damage is additionally halved on top of the Berry's own reduction — a distinct mechanic from the heal/stat doubling above, not just "the Berry's effect is doubled"
